onboarding_contracts.name: Post-Quantum External Identity Verification Contract
postconditions: Registers entity identity triple under target domain tenant.
preconditions: External agent must provide valid PQ public key coordinates.
Signature handle must match source domain registration.

onboarding_contracts.name: ZKP Envelope Validation Contract
postconditions: Grants external agent routing access under policy table.
preconditions: Submitted proof envelope must be verified under CEAP-D4+.
Zero raw state payload bytes must be leaked during validation.

onboarding_contracts.name: CEAP-D4+ Routing Access Grant Contract
postconditions: Adds agent to target domain active routing table.
Appends onboarding event block to cross-ecosystem journal.
preconditions: Both PQ identity and ZKP envelope verification certificates must be active.
Agent scope must match assigned tenant isolation boundary.
